text: Since your sleep study and metabolic workup are normal, and you deny excessive daytime sleepiness, we need to explore potential psychiatric causes or rare neurological conditions. speaker: Doctor
text: Since you've ruled out myalgic encephalomyelitis and toxic exposures, have you noticed any specific triggers that worsen your fatigue, such as bright lights, loud noises, or strong smells? text: Since your immunoglobulin levels are also normal, we have effectively ruled out most common infectious, autoimmune, and metabolic causes. Given your normal sleep study and lack of specific triggers, have you noticed any improvement or worsening of your symptoms during specific seasons, or do you feel a general sense of malaise rather than just tiredness? DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (Myalgic Encephalomyelitis)
